$comment: Every ML model the engine runs, in one place (electron/modelManifest.ts reads it). `id` is the folder under <userData>/models/ (the user's install) and, for a bundled model, under <resources>/models/ (scripts/fetchModels.cjs stages it, electron-builder ships it). `env` names the engine variables: PREMATION_<env>_USER_DIR (the user's install) and PREMATION_<env>_DIR (the bundled copy). `source` is `pinned` (the URLs and checksums below are the only accepted ones) or `user` (the person supplies the URL; a `url` below is a default, not a pin). A `sha256` of null means no checksum is known for that file today — none has been invented; such a file is checked only for being an ONNX protobuf of at least `minBytes`.

models.name: Object Matte (SlimSAM-77)
models.description: Segment-anything model behind one-click Roto subject selection. Bundled with the app; a different SAM-class pair can be installed over it.

models.name: Face landmarks (MediaPipe Face Mesh)
models.description: 468- or 478-point face mesh for the Tracker's Face tracking: a 192×192 RGB input, planar or interleaved (native/engine/src/jobs/face_ort_ffi.cpp). No pinned source is known with certainty, so the URL is supplied in Settings and downloaded on first use.
models.licence: Apache-2.0 (MediaPipe) — the chosen export's own licence applies

models.name: Depth Anything V2 Small
models.description: Monocular depth for Make 3D from Photo / Video. Downloaded on first use from a pinned Hugging Face revision; the checksum is verified before anything is installed.

models.name: Hand tracking (MediaPipe palm + hand landmarks)
models.description: Palm detector and hand landmarker for live performance input (OpenCV Zoo ONNX exports). Bundled with the app; both files are pinned to an exact revision and checksum.
